name: EyeCare America
description: EyeCare America is a public service program of the American Academy of Ophthalmology that matches uninsured and underinsured adults 18+ with volunteer ophthalmologists for a medical eye exam at no out-of-pocket cost.
fullDescription: EyeCare America is a public service program of the American Academy of Ophthalmology that matches uninsured and underinsured adults 18+ with volunteer ophthalmologists for a medical eye exam at no out-of-pocket cost.
whatTheyOffer:
- Medical eye exam by a volunteer ophthalmologist
- Up to one year of follow-up visits for conditions found at the first exam
- No out-of-pocket cost for covered exam and follow-up care
- Does NOT cover glasses, contacts, eyeglass prescriptions, surgery, medications, or tests
- One-time referral program
howToGetIt: You must be 18 or older, a US citizen or legal resident, have no HMO, PPO, private insurance, or VA benefits, not have seen an ophthalmologist in 3+ years, and not have used EyeCare America before. Fill out the online referral questionnaire to get matched right away, or call 877-887-6327 (Mon-Fri 8am-2pm PT). Not for urgent eye problems.
keywords: EyeCare America, free eye exam, medical eye exam, uninsured, underinsured, glaucoma, ophthalmologist, American Academy of Ophthalmology
